title: coreopsis monticola
intro: Coreopsis monticola, commonly known as the mountain tickseed, is a perennial plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Native American and folk practices, due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Coreopsis monticola include its ability to reduce pain and fever, as well as its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, although more research is needed to fully understand its medicinal properties.
